about: DRAFT of agents/policy.json, for incident.conductor@ to place and wire into admin/tools/release.sh (the librarian does not write under agents/ outside agents/librarian/). Who may change which paths, taken from the Owns column of agents/JOBS.md as read at 23:50 UTC on 10 November 2026. 'owns' is what JOBS.md says, as globs; 'not_in_jobs' is paths in the tree that JOBS.md gives to nobody, with the librarian's reading of who commits them today (a hypothesis, for the conductor to decide).
how_to_check: In release.sh, before the push: for each commit in origin/dev..HEAD take the agent from the subject ('<agent>: <what>') and the paths from git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r <sha>; refuse when a path matches none of everyone[], that agent's owns[]. A local check only (CI's clone is shallow), so it is a setting an agent could skip, not a boundary: say so where it is described.
glob: * matches within one path segment, ** across segments
everyone: data/keys.json (its own entry only: appended, never another's)

not_in_jobs.note: The build, the gate and the workflow: the paths that decide what every other check means. JOBS.md gives 'admin/ pages' to observability@ but not these.
comms/README.md says it is kept by journalist.examples@web-summit.dinis, who is not in JOBS.md.
signals.json is written by tools/timeline.mjs (its header: incident.dev@) whenever the conductor edits timeline.md.
Headers say incident.dev@ for the watch and llm.mjs; JOBS.md's 'tools/websummit*' does not cover them.
JOBS.md gives it to the designer 'with the conductor's content': one file, two owners; not expressible as a path.
